description: A product line (not an add-on) of the given order, with the line item id the returns API expects (ZnodeOrderProduct.OrderProductId). For an order the test created.

order.description: Order number (ZnodeOrder.ClassNumber): link it to the test's created order (@order.orderNumber) Left out (verification only): any order.

sku.description: SKU of the line (ZnodeOrderProduct.SKU). Left out: any line of the order
